jobs.description: Description Operations is at the heart of Amazon's business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey! About The Role As the Business Intelligence Engineer II, Workforce Analytics, you will play a crucial role in driving data-informed decision making for the North America RME Strategy team. You will design and deliver analytical solutions that provide visibility into workforce effectiveness, headcount trends, and operational performance across our network of fulfillment centers, sortation centers, and last-mile delivery stations. This role offers a unique opportunity to develop both technical and strategic capabilities while shaping the future of RME's workforce analytics infrastructure. What Do We Offer? Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there's more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety! Key job responsibilities You will design and maintain scalable reporting and analytical systems; including data models, SQL queries, and Python scripts that enable real-time tracking of workforce effectiveness, headcount trends, and operational performance across the RME network. You will develop comprehensive data visualizations and dashboards using tools like Amazon Quick, Microsoft Excel, and other visualization tools to surface workforce KPIs, attrition insights, and employee relations data for strategic decision-making. You will evaluate and integrate data across multiple systems — including learning and training tracking compliance systems, PXT systems, overtime, PRM (Parts, Repairs & Maintenance), Finance, and GPO data platforms — to build automated reporting solutions that support RME workforce planning initiatives. You will partner with stakeholders across HR, Finance, and RME Field Leadership to translate complex business questions into analytical frameworks, driving data-informed decisions at scale. You will support cross-functional initiatives and network-wide projects, with travel up to 15% to fulfillment centers, sortation centers, and last-mile delivery stations as needed. A day in the life Your day centers on driving data-informed decisions across the RME network. You'll start by reviewing ticket queues and updating project status in Taskei/Sim, ensuring alignment with quarterly roadmaps. Throughout the day, you'll build and maintain QuickSight visualizations for operational metrics, collaborate with partner teams to unlock new data sources, and optimize existing SQL queries for performance tracking. You'll spend time working with teams across Amazon's tech landscape - from Operations Technology to HR Systems - while documenting progress and sharing insights through regular stakeholder updates. About The Team The North America Reliability and Maintenance Engineering (NA RME) Strategy team drives the long-term vision for Amazon's maintenance organization. Supporting a network of over 1,500 facilities and more than 20,000 maintenance professionals (Amazon employees and third-party providers), we develop strategic initiatives to improve maintenance efficiency and enhance equipment reliability across our fulfillment network. Working closely with RME leadership, Finance, Operations, PXT, Talent Acquisition, and Technology teams, we deliver data-driven insights that shape maintenance program investments, workforce planning, and technology adoption to maintain Amazon's world-class operational standards. jobs.title: BI Developer (SQL/Power BI)
jobs.description: Overview Cherre, a Realpage Company, is the leader in real estate data and insight. Our front end product suite, built in Power BI, is how clients see and act on the data connected to the Cherre platform. You will build and run the dashboards and data models on top of Cherre's dimensional model: asset management, portfolio overview, financial and operational performance, valuations, loan performance, benchmarking, and data validation reporting for institutional investors, asset managers, and pension funds. You will work with Client Success, Product, and Engineering, and you will join clients directly when the work calls for it. Strong SQL and Power BI skills are the foundation. Real estate know-how is what sets you apart. Responsibilities ABOUT YOU 3 to 5 years in BI development or analytics engineering, ideally in real estate, prop-tech, or financial services. A portfolio of dashboards you can walk us through. Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience. Discretion with confidential client financial data. What You Will Do Build reusable reporting. Design Power BI reports and semantic models as standardized, white-label templates first, then configure them per client. Take on custom visuals (multi-level entity roll-ups, field-parameter views, client-specific KPIs) when scoped, and flag patterns that should become product. Model the data. Write SQL against BigQuery, Snowflake, and Azure SQL. Build star-schema models fed by Yardi, MRI, VTS, Chatham, Argus, RealPage, and client-submitted data. Write DAX for budget vs. actual, T-12, and year-over-year logic. Run Power BI Service. Manage DEV, UAT, and PROD workspaces in our embedded environment: deployment pipelines, row-level security, refresh, capacity, and performance tuning. Support clients using templates in their own tenant. Ship like an engineer. Keep reports as PBIP files in GitHub with peer review and naming standards. Use AI coding assistants to speed up model changes, testing, and documentation. Work with clients. Join requirements sessions, present dashboards, support UAT, and answer data validation questions from client finance and analyst teams. Catch bad numbers (GL mapping gaps, missing lease dates, occupancy over 100%) before clients do. Stay organized. Track work in Monday.com and JIRA, handle escalations from Client Success, and contribute to user guides, demos, and release testing. Qualifications MUST HAVE 3+ years of BI development with Power BI as your main tool: advanced DAX, Power Query (M), and dimensional modeling Strong SQL: CTEs, window functions, performance tuning Power BI Service: workspaces, deployment pipelines, row-level security, refresh 2+ years with real estate data and metrics: rent roll, NOI, occupancy, leasing, capex, budget vs. actual Comfortable running a client working session and explaining metric logic to executives A product mindset and the habit of validating your numbers first NICE TO HAVE Hands-on with Yardi, MRI, RealPage, VTS, or Argus data; GL and chart of accounts mapping Power BI Embedded or multi-tenant delivery; PBIP, Git, and CI Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt, or Python PL-300 or DP-600 certification B2B SaaS client delivery or implementation experience Salary And Benefits RealPage provides a competitive salary package along with a comprehensive benefit plan that includes: Health, dental, and vision insurance. Retirement savings plan with company match. Paid time off and holidays. Professional development opportunities. Performance-based bonus based on position. Compensation may vary depending on your location, qualifications including job-related education, training, experience, licensure, and certification, that could result at a level outside of these ranges. Certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including annual bonus, and sales incentives depending on the terms of the applicable plan and role as well as individual performance. jobs.description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. Data Engineer 🔐 About Our Security Team As Wayve’s security program grows, we need a scalable way to measure control effectiveness, automate evidence collection and provide continuous visibility into our security posture. As a Data Engineer, you’ll join the Security team and build the data and automation capabilities that underpin our security program. You’ll work across Security to design scalable data pipelines, data models, integrations and automations that transform security data into actionable insights. Your work will improve operational decision-making, reduce manual effort and strengthen our ability to support customer, auditor and regulatory commitments. This is an opportunity to build Wayve’s security analytics capability from the ground up, defining the architecture, data models and automations that become the foundation for how we measure and improve security. 🧠 Your day-to-day You’ll help make security governance continuous by partnering with Security Engineering, IT and Engineering teams to automate evidence collection, measure control effectiveness and establish the foundations of a data-driven security program. You’ll build and maintain security data pipelines, integrate information from cloud, identity, engineering and security platforms, and develop analytics and visualisations that make our security posture easier to understand and act on. You’ll also identify opportunities to replace repetitive manual processes with scalable engineering solutions. This role is well suited to someone motivated by automation who believes security data should be continuously available, reliable and actionable. 🧩 What You’ll Be Working On Designing, building and maintaining scalable data pipelines that collect, transform and enrich security data from systems across Wayve. Integrating data from identity, cloud, engineering and security platforms to create a unified view of Wayve’s security posture. Building robust data models that provide high-fidelity datasets for security analytics, operational reporting and measuring control effectiveness. Designing analytics products and visualisations that provide meaningful insights into the health, maturity and performance of the security program. Ensuring data quality, lineage, reliability, observability and maintainability across our security analytics platform. Building automated evidence-collection capabilities that reduce manual effort across governance, customer assurance and security operations. Developing analytics that support continuous control monitoring and demonstrate control effectiveness through measurable outcomes. Partnering with stakeholders across Security to translate security controls into measurable, automated indicators where practical. Designing and implementing automations that replace repetitive operational processes with scalable engineering solutions. Partnering with subject-matter experts to develop meaningful KPIs and metrics that help Security understand performance, risk, trends and operational health. Working with stakeholders across Security to understand analytical requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions. Continuously improving how security data is collected, modeled and consumed across the organization. During your first year, you’ll establish the foundations of Wayve’s security analytics and automation capability, including continuous security data pipelines, automated evidence collection for selected key controls, meaningful security KPIs and reusable data products. Your work will help move the Security program from periodic assessment toward continuous measurement and assurance. 🙌 You Should Apply If You have experience designing and operating reliable data platforms or analytics engineering solutions in production environments. You have experience building production-quality data pipelines and automation using Python, SQL or similar technologies. You have experience modeling data for analytical use cases. You have a strong understanding of modern data engineering practices, including data modeling, ETL/ELT, API integrations, data quality and observability. You have experience working in cloud-native environments and integrating data from cloud platforms and SaaS sources. You have experience building integrations and automation using APIs rather than relying solely on out-of-the-box platform capabilities. You bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills and can translate complex technical data into actionable insights. You have experience designing dashboards and metrics that support operational or business decision-making. You have excellent communication skills and can collaborate effectively across Security, Engineering and other technical teams. Experience working within cybersecurity, security engineering or security governance is a plus. Awareness of security frameworks such as TISAX, ISO 27001 and NIST CSF is a plus. Experience measuring control effectiveness, building security metrics or implementing continuous assurance capabilities is a plus. Familiarity with security telemetry, identity systems, cloud platforms, endpoint security or vulnerability-management tooling is a plus. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More About Wayve 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻 – Locations & Flexible Working: This is a full-time role based in Sunnyvale, CA (hybrid) . The reasonably estimated salary range for this role is $186,100–$243,300, plus a competitive equity package . Actual compensation is based on the candidate’s skills, qualifications and experience. Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces and workshops with focused time working remotely. We also operate core working hours, allowing you to determine the schedule that works best for you and your team. 🔍 The Interview Process Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins) Competency interviews (Hiring Manager Interview) (45 mins) Deep-dive interviews (Technical Interviews) (1.5 hrs) Final interview (30 mins) We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s In It For You 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. For more information visit Careers at Wayve. jobs.description: Requisition Number: 79606 The company built on breakthroughs. Join us. Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible. How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward. At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more. Come break through with us. Our Optical Communications segment has recently evolved from being a manufacturer of optical fiber and cable, hardware and equipment to being a comprehensive provider of industry-leading optical solutions across the broader communications industry.This segment is classified into two main product groupings – carrier network and enterprise network. The carrier network product group consists primarily of products and solutions for optical-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data and voice communications. The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use. Purpose of Position The Process Data Scientist will serve as an embedded technical partner to process engineering and manufacturing teams, applying traditional statistics, advanced analytics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to improve process understanding, control, capability, quality, yield, and cost. The role connects rigorous statistical thinking with modern data-science methods to convert manufacturing and quality data into practical, scalable solutions. The individual will work with data from manufacturing execution systems, measurement and inspection equipment, process-control systems, sensors, ERP systems, and quality systems. Work will range from designed experiments and statistical process control to predictive modeling, anomaly detection, optimization, computer vision, and responsible use of generative AI. The role requires hands-on analysis, close collaboration with process experts, and clear communication of methods, assumptions, uncertainty, and business impact. This person will be expected to work independently in ambiguous problem spaces, select methods appropriate to the process and data, and help move successful analytical solutions from exploratory analysis into sustained use across manufacturing sites. Key Responsibilities Partner with process engineering, manufacturing, quality, technology, IT, and data engineering teams to frame business and technical questions as well-defined analytical problems. Plan, execute, and analyze designed experiments, statistical process control, measurement system analyses, hypothesis tests, and other statistical methods. Analyze manufacturing and quality data to identify sources of variation, quantify relationships among inputs and outputs, establish evidence-based conclusions, and recommend actions. Develop predictive and prescriptive models using machine learning and statistical techniques for applications such as anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, throughput improvement, process optimization, and defect reduction. Explore and apply AI capabilities, including computer vision and generative AI, in a manufacturing setting. Use Python, SQL, and big-data platforms including Databricks to prepare data, engineer features, build reproducible analyses, and work effectively with large and complex datasets. Collaborate with data engineering and IT partners to define analysis-ready datasets, data-quality checks, contextual data requirements, and scalable analytical workflows. Create dashboards, reports, visualizations, and technical summaries that communicate process performance, analytical findings, limitations, and recommended actions to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Develop reusable analytical methods, code, templates, and standards that improve consistency across sites and reduce duplicated effort. Train and coach engineers and other stakeholders in statistical thinking, data interpretation, and appropriate use of advanced analytics and AI. Deliver value where problems may be loosely defined and data may be incomplete, requiring initiative, sound judgment, scientific rigor, and attention to detail. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in data science, statistics, or a related field, preferably in a manufacturing or industrial setting. Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using big data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Spark, and Hadoop). Strong foundation in statistical modeling, machine learning, and data mining techniques. Advanced data visualization skills using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools. Excellent communication and leadership skills with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization. Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree or Ph.D. in a data-related field, such as statistics, data science, computer science, or a related discipline. Experience with manufacturing systems (MES, ERP) and industrial data platforms (e.g., OSI PI). Familiarity with MLOps practices and tools for model deployment and monitoring. Experience with JMP and/or Minitab statistical software. Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma, quality engineering, process improvement, and Manufacturing 4.0 concepts. Bilingual or multilingual capability and experience working with global teams. Soft Skills Strong collaborator who can build productive relationships with process experts and cross-functional partners. Curious and hypothesis-driven, with the judgment to distinguish correlation, prediction, and causation. Self-motivated and able to define a path forward with limited direction. Comfortable balancing analytical rigor, speed, practical constraints, and business value. Able to challenge assumptions constructively and communicate limitations transparently. Able to train, coach, and influence others in statistical and data-driven thinking. Detail-oriented, with a strong focus on accuracy, reproducibility, documentation, and follow-through. Travel Requirements Up to 20%, including international travel to support global teams and initiatives. Normal business hours are expected, with flexibility to collaborate across regions and time zones as needed. This position does not support immigration sponsorship. The range for this position is $91,311.00 - $125,553.00 assuming full time status. Starting pay for the successful applicant is dependent on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education. A job that shapes a life. Corning offers you the total package. Your well-being is our priority. Our compensation and benefits package supports your health and wellness, financial aspirations, and career from day one. Company-wide bonuses and long-term incentives align with key business results and ensure you are rewarded when the company performs well. When Corning wins, we all win. As part of our commitment to your financial well-being, we provide a 100% company-paid pension benefit with fixed contributions that grow throughout your career. Combined with matching contributions to your 401(k) savings plan, Corning’s total contributions to your retirement accounts can reach between 7% and 12% of your pay, depending on your age and years of service. Our health and well-being benefits include medical, dental, vision, paid parental leave, family building support, fitness, company-paid life insurance, disability, disease management programs, paid time off, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) to support you and your family. Getting paid for our work is important, but feeling appreciated and recognized for those contributions motivates us much more. That’s why Corning offers a recognition program to celebrate successes and reward colleagues who make exceptional contributions.
